    n = 26

    side = 5
    x = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, side)
    y = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, side)
    xv, yv = np.meshgrid(x, y)
    centers = np.vstack([xv.ravel(), yv.ravel()]).T
    
    # Add the 26th circle near a corner to break symmetry and fill a gap
    extra = np.array([[0.5, 0.5]])
    centers = np.vstack([centers, extra])

    # Iterative repulsion to maximize space between centers

                diff = centers[i] - centers[j]
                dist = np.linalg.norm(diff)

                    centers[i] += push
                    centers[j] -= push
            centers[i] = np.clip(centers[i], 0.09, 0.91)

    radii = compute_max_radii(centers)
    return centers, radii, np.sum(radii)
